verdict.rationale: Adaptive streaming quality and user-set resolution and frame rate are a fair question for a remote-desktop product like TeamViewer, so the axis applies. The evidence pack has no documentation or hands-on report of adaptive bitrate or quality, or of manual resolution and frame-rate controls. The docs cover pricing, management, AI and AR features, and the community comments are general sentiment rather than anything about streaming quality.

support.subject: As a power user, quality adapts when the link falls behind, and I can set resolution and frame rate myself
